label: Pattaya Central Beach Road / Second Road 500m test area
selection_reason: Central Pattaya has a mix of primary streets, local sois and compact tourist-block intersections.
The 500m square is small enough for fast iteration but complex enough for endpoint snapping, junction clustering and lane inference research.
The area is suitable for comparing OSM tags, Overture connectors and later paid API data without touching the main VirtualCity pipeline.
